nodes_add.name: Tulsi Sahib of Hathras
nodes_add.note: Sant poet, author of Ghat Ramayan; teacher of Shiv Dayal Singh's parents, stayed in their house in Panni Gali, Agra. No record that he initiated Shiv Dayal Singh.

nodes_add.name: Salig Ram (Huzur Maharaj)
nodes_add.note: Postal official, Postmaster-General of the North-Western Provinces from 1881; met Shiv Dayal Singh 1858; asked for the public satsang of 1861; gave the faith the name Radhasoami; head of the main Agra group 1878-1898.

nodes_update.name: Shiv Dayal Singh (Soamiji)
nodes_update.note: Founder of the Radhasoami faith; opened public satsang at Panni Gali, Agra, on Basant Panchami, 15 February 1861. Succession disputed between branches.

nodes_update.name: Mahatma Gandhi
nodes_update.note: Religious thought: Truth is God, ahimsa, satyagraha, the ashram vows, a nonviolent reading of the Gita.

edges_upsert.note: Sant poet in the line of Kabir
Sant vocabulary of Naam and Shabd
Sahajdhari Sikh family; the Guru Granth Sahib quoted constantly

Family teacher who held satsang in the Panni Gali house; whether he was Shiv Dayal Singh's guru is disputed, and no initiation is recorded. Girdhari Das (died 1860), Tulsi Sahib's disciple, also taught him.
Met 21 November 1858 per the Peepal Mandi branch; Agra branches trace their succession through him, which other branches dispute
Year per the Beas branch's account; Beas traces its line through him
Met in Bombay 1891; Gandhi named him first of the three moderns who left a deep impress on his life, but said he could not enthrone him as guru
Ahimsa and vows in Kathiawar; the Jain monk Becharji Swami administered his 1888 vows
Sermon on the Mount (London, c. 1890); Tolstoy's The Kingdom of God Is Within You (1894)
Joined the ashram 1916; chosen first individual satyagrahi 1940
Poona Pact 1932; Annihilation of Caste exchange 1936-37; What Congress and Gandhi Have Done to the Untouchables (1945)

glossary.def: The Radhasoami practice of joining the attention (surat) to an inner current of sound (shabd) and following it upward.
Gandhi's word for firmness in truth: nonviolent resistance in which the resister accepts suffering instead of inflicting it.
Nonviolence; not harming living beings in deed, word or thought.
Celibacy; for Gandhi, control of all the senses in thought, word and deed.
Non-attachment, especially to the fruits of one's actions, as taught in the Bhagavad Gita.
The person of steady wisdom described in the second chapter of the Bhagavad Gita.

shiv-dayal-singh: Born 25 Aug 1818; opened satsang 15 Feb 1861 (Basant Panchami) at Panni Gali; name Radhasoami c.1866; died 15 June 1878; wife Naraini Devi daughter of Izzat Rai of Faridabad; Persian jobs; practice from age six; quotes 'easier than pranayam' and 'pre-requisite' -> https://www.radhasoamisatsang.org/?p=30

Parents Seth Dilwali Singh and Mata Maha Maya; brothers Partap Singh, Rai Bindraban; Juergensmeyer on Agra base and Sikh recruits; no initiation from Tulsi Sahib; SPIRICON 2010 boycott; processions rule; Twitchell letter 8 July 1963 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shiv_Dayal_Singh

Tulsi Sahib stayed in family house; family disciples; Girdhari Das; last words 'Sat Naam and Anami' (Dayalbagh translation); Ghat Ramayan regions -> https://santmat.substack.com/p/shiv-dayal-singhs-path-of-sat-naam
Tulsi Sahib 1763-1843; no record of initiating Shiv Dayal; Girdhari Das died 1860 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulsi_Sahib
Salig Ram born 14 Mar 1829, met 21 Nov 1858, first Indian PMG NWP 1881, died 6 Dec 1898 -> https://www.radhasoamisatsang.org/?p=51

Successors after 1878; Central Administrative Council 1902; 111 of 116 branches to Kamta Prasad Sinha; Beas 1891; ~2 million initiates estimate; Dera Sacha Sauda 1948; Manavta Mandir 1962; six elements -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radha_Soami
Jaimal Singh born July 1839 near Batala; initiated 1856 in Agra; havildar; died 1903 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaimal_Singh

Agam Prasad Mathur guru since 1959 -> https://www.radhasoamisatsang.org/?p=83; great-great-grandson and VC Agra University -> https://www.patrika.com/agra-news/radhasoami-guru-dadaji-maharaj-birth-day-special-stoty-latest-news-4893726/

Jasdeep Singh Gill named patron and successor-designate 2 Sept 2024; Dhillon continues -> https://rssb.org/JSG.html ; https://tribuneindia.com/news/punjab/beas-dera-names-gill-as-spiritual-head-retracts-hours-later
Soami Bagh samadh construction began 1908 (official tourism) -> https://incredibleindia.gov.in/en/uttar-pradesh/agra/radhasoami-samadhi-soamibagh-temple
gandhi: 'But two years ago I went a step further and said that Truth is God'; Young India 31 Dec 1931; Bradlaugh; sat -> https://www.mkgandhi.org/truthisgod/04truthisgod.php
'more correct to say that Truth is God, than to say that God is Truth' -> https://gandhiashramsevagram.org/from-yeravda-mandir/chapter-01-truth.php
'To me the Gita became the guide of conduct. It became my dictionary of daily reference.'; thirteen chapters memorised while washing -> https://www.mkgandhi.org/storyofmylife/33gita.php

Theosophist brothers end of second year; 'priceless worth'; Sermon on the Mount; unify Gita, Light of Asia, Sermon; renunciation -> https://www.mkgandhi.org/storyofmylife/14acquaintance_with_religions.php
Raychandbhai 'by his living contact'; Tolstoy; Ruskin; 'The throne has remained vacant' -> https://www.mkgandhi.org/my_religion/06raychandbhai.php
1931 recorded talk on God, London, Kingsley Hall -> https://www.openculture.com/2015/01/hear-gandhis-famous-speech-on-the-existence-of-god-1931.html
Bose's March 1947 departure and dispute over its cause -> https://www.theindiaforum.in/book-reviews/always-gandhis-side
